sources.name: useragent.in — In-App Browsers category
sources.datasetFile: discover from index.json; do not guess a filename
sourceNotes: The category page reports 108 in-app browser user-agent entries.
The site says in-app entries are transcribed from real observed traffic; desktop/mobile/tablet categories are generated from real components.
The page warns that not every generated cross-product row corresponds to a shipping configuration; retain row-level source classification.
The terms permit download, use, modification and redistribution including commercial use; attribution is appreciated but not required.
sources.nextAction: Fetch index.json, discover the exact In-App Browsers dataset filename, preserve raw JSON and decoder version, then ingest rows with source row IDs.

sources.name: GitHub inapp-debugger issue #16 — user-submitted observed examples
sourceNotes: Contains user-submitted iOS Facebook and Instagram in-app UA examples; sample app versions are historical and must not be mixed with current app version/build pairs.

sources.name: DeviceAtlas — mobile browser user-agent strings
sourceNotes: Search index exposes a Facebook iOS in-app sample and explains the distinction between Safari and embedded WebViews.
Contains a raw Facebook iOS in-app UA from DeviceAtlas traffic; the article identifies it as the Facebook in-app browser and describes its September 2026 traffic analysis.

sources.name: Appy — in-app browser checker
sourceNotes: Describes in-app browser behavior and an Instagram sample shape; corroboration is still required for any verified NEXORA template.

sources.name: HackerNoon — How to Detect Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok In-App Browsers
sourceNotes: Published 2026-11-25; author says example strings were collected in October 2026.
Confirms current Facebook Android FB_IAB/FB4A token and that current Facebook Android builds no longer send wv.
Messenger, Threads, LinkedIn, Snapchat and X entries are explicitly attributed to inapp-spy rules and marked not tested in the article; treat them as token leads only.

records.source_format: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; {android}; {model} Build/{build}; wv) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/{chrome} Mobile Safari/537.36 [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/{fb};IABMV/1;] OR [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/{fb};]

review_notes: Candidate only. Script randomizes app and Chrome versions, and creates build suffixes; no generated values are accepted as evidence.

records.template: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; K) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/158.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36 [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/{appVersion};IABMV/1;]

compatibility.notes: One observed reduced-UA variant. Android 10; K is a literal reduced-UA token, not the handset's actual OS/model. Chrome/158.0.0.0 is held literal; do not replace it with the catalog's Chrome 159 value without a matching observation.

evidence.observed: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 10; K) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/158.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36 [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/588.0.0.42.55;IABMV/1;]

Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 16; CPH2895 Build/BP2A.250605.031.A3) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/4.0 Chrome/158.0.8127.62 Mobile Safari/537.36 [FB_IAB/FB4A;FBAV/588.0.0.42.55;IABMV/1;]

evidence.quoted_text: Current Facebook Android uses FB_IAB/FB4A and no longer sends wv.

review_notes: Pending official collector/validator run; this record is not added to the proposal or runtime catalog.

The app version/build pair 588.0.0.42.55 / 707615019 exists together in the attached devices-2026.11.25.7.json current values. The UA emits FBAV but not FBBV; the build is joined from the exact catalog version record, not copied from the UA.
This is a distinct no-wv reduced-UA variant. Do not merge it with the older Motorola candidate containing '; wv)' or the Samsung device/build candidate.

Only appVersion is dynamic. The Android 10; K and Chrome/158.0.0.0 base is preserved literally from the observed variant. The current meta.versions.chrome is 159.0.8154.33, so a dynamic Chrome slot is not supported by this observation.

The spec says the published device baseline is 2026.11.25.6, while PROJECT_CONTEXT.md and the attached device file identify 2026.11.25.7. The version/build match is provisional until that baseline discrepancy is resolved.

collectionGaps: useragent.in category file not retrieved in this run: browser fetch returned HTTP 429 and Python urllib could not resolve the host. The exact dataset filename must be discovered from index.json on the GitHub Actions collection runner.
No raw useragent.in rows have been copied into findings; 108 is a source-reported category count, not 108 records collected by NEXORA.
The supplied Python scripts generate randomized app versions, build IDs, FBRV/Instagram IDs, and some device fields; they remain candidate format evidence only.
The current meta.apps version/build history must be matched exactly before any observed template can become verified.
